whatItDoes: Authorize up to $4.9 million in additional annual property taxes for Weld County School District RE-8 and continue $2.675 million in existing taxes scheduled to expire. Money would support school operations, including teacher and staff compensation, expanded programs and career and technical education, and additional educators. A variable property-tax levy would be set each year to raise the stated fixed amounts, in addition to other taxes under state law. The measure would approve a revenue change. The question states no end date for either authorization.
yesMeans: Approve both the new annual tax authority and extension of the expiring taxes.
noMeans: Reject the proposed new taxes and extension; the existing taxes would retain their current expiration schedule.
